method: Expanded CRyPTIC v3.4 BDQ cohort (HIGH+MEDIUM, exclude KM): 23,441 isolates / 1,046 R. LR F2, S1 patient-grouped 5-fold nested Platt + thresholds (same protocol as golden E04).
interpretation: Expanded training AUC 0.8381 vs golden 0.9085 (delta -0.0704); sens@spec0.985 0.6195. +182 new resistant isolates, CRyPTIC R 83->255.
caveats: Different cohort than golden (not the published 11,868 reproduction). MEDIUM labels add noise. Descriptive; golden baseline + production untouched; no tuning. KM held out.
supports: Data-richness lever: more resistant isolates to improve generalization.
